role: Synthetic forecast-research department profiles and immutable short-horizon forecasts for the current and next oil main contracts.

capability_total_score.note: Internal weighted summary used for synthetic-demo generation constraints; not a player-facing recruitment rating.

invariants: capability scores are hidden runtime skill parameters and research-style scores are hidden preferences, not player-facing recruitment ratings
research-style dimensions have no total score and no style value is universally better
capability correlations arise from shared latent professional traits plus idiosyncratic variation rather than hard pairwise compatibility bonuses
research style affects only the institution forecast process and never writes directly to strategy sizing, risk approval, execution, or market prices
the forecast covers only the current main and next-main named contracts
the continuous main series remains non-tradable and is never a forecast target
each vintage predicts only weeks after its half-month information cutoff
forecast OHLC always satisfies low <= min(open, close) <= max(open, close) <= high
ordinary forecast output contains no hidden actual future bars
scores use only weeks realized by the evaluation cutoff
historical vintages remain immutable so later revisions cannot overwrite prior forecasts
the forecast and its scores never write back to oil prices, liquidity, macro rows, or player positions
